run:ci.yml:pr.why: light checks; the pull request waits on this (5-10 minute target)

run:ci.yml:pr-wide.why: graphty-element src/ or global inputs changed

run:release.yml:full.why: full run plus the release lanes

job:ci.yml:Run cap.why: a pull request waits here for a turn; tools/ci-run-cap.mjs gives up at 25 min

job:ci.yml:Selector import graphs.why: master only: a cold walk of every package's Vite import graph, off the critical path

job:release.yml:Version dry run.why: nx release version took 13 min on 2026-10-26 (#3631)

job:release.yml:Version the release.why: the same nx release version as the dry run (#3631)

task:graphty:build.why: 1m23s before the Sentry regression, 60-63 s after the fix (uncached)

job:ci.yml:Stories (*).why: story bins of at most 8 min plus setup (report-only)

ttg:full.why: red full run to the next green one

bytes:lfs.why: Team allowance 250 GiB, a hard block

bytes:actions-cache.why: 10 GB limit; LRU eviction above it

job:ci.yml:Cache hygiene.why: one list call and a delete per superseded key

cache:codeql-*.why: per ref: CodeQL overlay base database, 1.3 GB for javascript

cache:lfs-*.why: per ref: one project's LFS baselines (graph-io-fidelity 0.54 GB, graphty 0.5 GB)

cache:node-cache-*.why: per ref: pnpm store 0.32 GB, two while an older lockfile is still read

cache:playwright-*.why: per ref, each of playwright-Linux (visual jobs, by version) and playwright-lock-Linux (test jobs, by lockfile): browsers 0.26 GB, two while an older one is still read

cache:test-select-graphs.why: per ref: the selector's import graphs, about 10 MB

cache:test-durations-*.why: per ref: a key per shard per run, KB each
